title: Signature Exact-Match Discipline
description: A Signature-original discipline: exact matching is always tried first, with normalization rules written down before the code; fuzzy methods are only reached after exact fails, and the fallback chain is logged. The discipline stops fuzzy-first designs that miss the easy wins. Signature-original.

title: Signature Typo Budget
description: A Signature-original budget for fuzzy matching: distance 1 for short strings, 2 for medium, scaled by length beyond that — with the budget written as a function, not a magic number. The budget's test suite includes the classic false friends that over-permissive fuzz lets through. Signature-original.

title: Signature Regex Review Ritual
description: A Signature-original ritual: every regex ships with three positive and three negative test cases, a comment stating what it matches in plain words, and a catastrophic-backtracking check on pathological input.
